# NeoForge 26.2 player-feedback boot (0.7.0): Croptopia + EpheroLib + Fish of
# Thieves 26.2.1.1 (+ Cloth Config 26.2.155) + Refurbished Furniture 1.0.25
# (+ Framework 0.13.26) on tools/neo-server-262. Every id below was checked
# against those 26.2 jars. c:milk, c:cheese and c:butter: no mod on this harness
# defines them natively (Croptopia 26.2 ships only the plural c:milks / c:cheeses /
# c:butters), so they exist here purely through Pantrywork's own generated files -
# the negative checks prove we never inject Croptopia's 16-per-bucket bottle, its
# soy milk, or the cheese/butter made from that bottle into them. The c:drinks/milk
# negatives prove Pantrywork no longer routes Croptopia's milks there either.
# Run via tools\rcon.ps1 -File tools\tagtest-neo26-feedback.txt
forceload add 0 0
setblock 8 -60 8 minecraft:chest
# --- Fish of Thieves fruits reach Croptopia's generic + per-fruit tags ---
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:banana
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:fruits
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:bananas
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:fruits/banana
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:coconut
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:coconuts
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:pineapple
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:pineapples
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:crownless_pineapple
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:pineapples
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:mango
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:mangos
# --- FoT exclusions: half/raw pieces stay out of per-fruit tags ---
# The mango_pit lines are a future-upstream guard, not proof of the blacklist: FoT
# files the pit only under c:seeds, so there is no current tag path and removing the
# blacklist entry still passes them. The live proof is tools\GenerateBridges.ps1 -SelfTest.
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:mango_pit
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:fruits/mango
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:mangos
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:fruits
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:half_pineapple
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:fruits/pineapple
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with fishofthieves:raw_mango
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:fruits/mango
# --- Refurbished Furniture ingredients join the dialect tags ---
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with refurbished_furniture:cheese
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:cheeses
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:cheese
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with refurbished_furniture:dough
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:doughs
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with refurbished_furniture:wheat_flour
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:flour
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:flours
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with refurbished_furniture:sea_salt
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:salts
# --- Refurbished exclusions: toast/slice (6 per bread) and 1-berry jam never bridged ---
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with refurbished_furniture:toast
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:toasts
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:toast
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with refurbished_furniture:bread_slice
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:toasts
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with refurbished_furniture:sweet_berry_jam
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:jellies/sweetberryjelly
# --- c:milk dilution (B1): Croptopia bottle/soy stay out of c:milk, native c:milks intact ---
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with croptopia:milk_bottle
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:milk
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:milks
# --- c:drinks/milk dilution (0.7.0 review): out of the recipe tag, still in the dairy role ---
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:drinks/milk
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #pantrywork:food_component/dairy
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with croptopia:soy_milk
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:milk
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:drinks/milk
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with minecraft:milk_bucket
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:drinks/milk
# --- c:cheese / c:butter dilution (0.7.0 review): bottle-made Croptopia cheese/butter keep their own plural tags only ---
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with croptopia:cheese
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:cheese
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:cheeses
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with croptopia:butter
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:butter
execute if items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:butters
# --- negative control ---
item replace block 8 -60 8 container.0 with minecraft:stone
execute unless items block 8 -60 8 container.0 #c:fruits
# --- CRAFT 1 (shaped): Croptopia pineapple_chicken ("#c:pineapples" + chicken) with a FoT pineapple ---
kill @e[type=item]
setblock 8 -60 12 minecraft:crafter[orientation=up_north]
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.0 with fishofthieves:pineapple
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.1 with minecraft:chicken
setblock 9 -60 12 minecraft:redstone_block
# two gametime queries = tick flow proof + crafter result lands before the check
time query gametime
time query gametime
execute if items entity @e[type=minecraft:item] contents croptopia:pineapple_chicken
kill @e[type=item]
setblock 9 -60 12 minecraft:air
setblock 8 -60 12 minecraft:air
# --- CRAFT 2 (shapeless): Croptopia banana_smoothie with a FoT banana ---
setblock 8 -60 12 minecraft:crafter[orientation=up_north]
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.0 with fishofthieves:banana
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.1 with minecraft:ice
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.2 with croptopia:milk_bottle
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.3 with minecraft:glass_bottle
setblock 9 -60 12 minecraft:redstone_block
time query gametime
time query gametime
execute if items entity @e[type=minecraft:item] contents croptopia:banana_smoothie
kill @e[type=item]
setblock 9 -60 12 minecraft:air
setblock 8 -60 12 minecraft:air
# --- CRAFT 3 (negative): half_pineapple must NOT stand in for #c:pineapples ---
setblock 8 -60 12 minecraft:crafter[orientation=up_north]
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.0 with fishofthieves:half_pineapple
item replace block 8 -60 12 container.1 with minecraft:chicken
setblock 9 -60 12 minecraft:redstone_block
time query gametime
time query gametime
execute if items block 8 -60 12 container.0 fishofthieves:half_pineapple
# No "execute unless items entity @e[...]" here: on 26.2 an empty selector ERRORS
# ("No entity was found") instead of passing. The unconsumed input above plus this
# kill reporting "No entity was found" is the negative proof (ticks shown above).
kill @e[type=item]
setblock 9 -60 12 minecraft:air
setblock 8 -60 12 minecraft:air
